# Project Ember

Project Ember aims to detect moorland wildfires within minutes, by spotting
heat and smoke before a fire spreads.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[hana-sato]] and runs from [[tolvan-lab]]. Detection
relies on the [[thermal-mast-tm2]].
